pattern.deadline_window: Late January to first days of February (verified: 2024-02-02, 2025-01-24 initial / 2025-01-31 final PDF, 2026-01-30); abstract/title one week earlier; all 23:59 AoE.
pattern.conference_month: Late June to mid-July, 5 days (verified: 2024-07-15..19 Delft, 2025-06-21..25 Los Angeles, 2026-07-13..17 Sydney, 2027-07-06..11 Athens).
pattern.location_rotation: Single-venue, rotates between North America, Europe and (since 2026) Asia-Pacific; the RSS Foundation board votes on the host two summers ahead (proposals due April 1 of year n for RSS n+2).
pattern.review_process: Double-blind with area chairs. Reviews are released about 7 weeks after the paper deadline, authors get a one-week rebuttal, decisions follow roughly 4-5 weeks later. Since 2025 there is a two-stage January deadline (semi-complete PDF, then final PDF one week later).
pattern.resubmission_rules: Dual submission strictly forbidden: 'Submitting a paper that is currently under submission to another conference (e.g. ICRA, ICLR, CVPR) is considered a double submission and is strictly forbidden.' arXiv/technical-report preprints are allowed ('It is acceptable to submit to RSS work that has been made available as a technical report (or similar, e.g., in arXiv) without citing it').

pattern.deadline_window: Rolling: submit any day. First decision (Accept / Reject / Revise-and-Resubmit) within 3 months; a single 30-day revision window; second and final decision within 5 months of initial submission (RA-L main page says 'within 6 months'); average submission-to-e-publication ~4 months. Final files due 14 days after acceptance.
pattern.notification_month: N/A (rolling). Plan ~3 months to first decision, ~5 months to final decision.
pattern.conference_month: Presentation option: an ACCEPTED RA-L paper can be transferred (within 270 days of acceptance, to ONE conference only) for presentation at ICRA / IROS / CASE / Humanoids / RoboSoft / AIM / BioRob / RO-MAN / CBS during a published window. The old simultaneous 'RA-L + ICRA/IROS submission option' was discontinued after IROS 2022.
pattern.review_process: Senior Editor + Associate Editor + at least two reviewers; one revise-and-resubmit round only (30 days, hard deadline); papers that miss the revision deadline are rejected.
pattern.resubmission_rules: Preliminary conference versions must be disclosed 'in a compact way'; a rejected RA-L paper may be reworked and resubmitted as a new submission. arXiv posting follows the IEEE author-posting policy (allowed). Camera-ready appears as a Rapid Posting preprint on Xplore.

notes: Rolling submissions; no fixed deadline. First decision within 3 months, revision 30 days, final decision within 5 months (information-for-authors page) / 'within 6 months' (RA-L main page); avg sub-to-epub ~4 months; final files 14 days after acceptance (hard).

Presentation-option cut-offs for 2026 (from the conference CFPs; the RA-L page now only lists 2027 windows): ICRA 2026 (Vienna, Jun 1-5, 2026) journal-transfer deadline Dec 31, 2025; CASE 2026 journal-presentation request Apr 30, 2026 (eligibility Dec 1, 2025 - May 2, 2026); IROS 2026 (Pittsburgh, Sep 27-Oct 1, 2026) eligibility window not published on its CFP page.

Presentation-option windows for 2027 (RA-L page, 'The paper must be transferred within 270 days of acceptance'; 'Eligible papers may only be presented at one conference'): ICRA 2027 (Seoul, May 24-28, 2027) Mar 1 - Dec 31, 2026 (ICRA CFP: 'The deadline for transfer of journal papers to ICRA 2027 is 31st December 2026'); IROS 2027 (Florence, Sep 26-Oct 1, 2027) Aug 1, 2026 - Apr 30, 2027; CASE 2027 Aug 1, 2026 - Apr 30, 2027; Humanoids 2027 Oct 1, 2026 - Jun 30, 2027; RoboSoft 2027 Apr 1 - Dec 31, 2026; AIM 2027 Sep 15, 2026 - Jun 1, 2027; BioRob 2027 Aug 1, 2026 - Apr 1, 2027; RO-MAN 2027 Sep 1, 2026 - Apr 30, 2027; CBS 2027 Aug 1, 2026 - Apr 30, 2027.
